stories.title: roopers remain at Kershaw Highway crash in Camden area after entrapment, fire officials say
stories.summary: Fire crews cleared a crash with entrapment on Kershaw Highway at 6:15 p.m., but the Highway Patrol will stay on scene for an extended time. Use caution.

stories.title: South Carolina man charged with homicide by child abuse in child's death, deputies say
stories.summary: An arrest warrant says a child died of blunt force trauma to the head. Jason Daniel Murray Jr., 22, was already jailed on drug and child-risk charges.

stories.title: Black Friday crowds pack Columbiana Centre as shoppers hunt for deals
stories.summary: Black Friday crowds flooded Midlands stores as shoppers sought bargains amid rising prices. Experts predict record participation this year due to affordability.

stories.title: Christmas tree season begins at Midlands farms. Here's what trees cost this year
stories.summary: Families are picking out Christmas trees at Price's Tree Farm in Lexington, where prices run from $30 to $240. Plus, more Midlands farms and care tips.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Methodist conference lawsuits against 21 Midlands churches seeking to leave
stories.summary: A judge ruled civil courts can't settle the UMC property fight with dozens of SC churches leaving the denomination. The conference says it will appeal.

stories.title: Black Friday safety: Midlands deputies urge shoppers to lock cars, hide bags and watch for scams
stories.summary: Lexington and Kershaw County deputies share Black Friday tips to keep shoppers safe from theft and scams. Here's what to know before you head out.

stories.title: South Carolina company recalls biscuit sandwiches over listeria risk
stories.summary: The Longs company said the sandwiches went to convenience stores, vending machines and prison canteens in the Carolinas and Virginia for over eight months.

stories.title: Chappelle Memorial A.M.E. Church carries on Edith General's free Thanksgiving dinner in Columbia
stories.summary: Edith General set out to feed people in need after meeting a hungry young man. More than 30 years later, her church's Thanksgiving dinner carries on.

stories.title: Coroner names 3 women in Elloree boarding home fire that investigators say was intentionally set
stories.summary: All three died of smoke inhalation, the coroner said. A 74-year-old resident is charged with first-degree arson.

stories.title: SC flu hospitalizations near 1,000, almost triple the usual pace for this point in the season
stories.summary: South Carolina reported 245 flu hospitalizations and two deaths the week before Thanksgiving. More than half of patients are 65 and older.

stories.title: Aiken Electric restores power after substation problem causes Thanksgiving outage
stories.summary: A bad lightning arrester at a substation knocked out power in Aiken Electric Cooperative's North district on Thanksgiving. Power is back on.

stories.title: Three people hurt in Lee County house fire on Tomarla Drive, firefighters say
stories.summary: Three people escaped a house fire on Tomarla Drive but were hurt and taken to a hospital, the Lee County Fire Department said. The cause is under investigation.
